modalities.evidence: 64 electrodes were placed on the head
a memory test was performed the next day

output.population: 18 participants, ages 18–26, who played two games during wakefulness and then slept in the MRI scanner
output.summary: Simultaneous EEG-fMRI dataset of participants playing face and maze games while awake, then sleeping in the scanner, with a next-day memory test, to study reward-biased neural reactivation during sleep.
